hero.title: Each gram
hero.subtitle: Jordan's home for serious athletes. Heavy iron, coaches who've been there, and a community that won't let you quit.
hero.sceneLabel: The GRAMS GYM GG monogram in brushed silver, surrounded by orbiting chrome calibration weights.

story.title: It starts with one gram.

s1.title: One gram
s1.body: Every rep. Every meal. Every night of sleep. Small, but it counts.

s2.title: Then a kettlebell
s2.body: Consistency turns grams into kilos. This is where habit becomes strength.

s3.title: Then a plate
s3.body: Twenty kilos of proof that you showed up when it was hard.

s4.title: Then the bar
s4.body: Twenty thousand grams of steel. You don't lift it once — you build up to it.

story.sceneLabel: A chrome calibration weight morphs into a kettlebell, an Olympic plate, then a barbell as you scroll.

packages.title: Pick your pace. Keep your promise.
packages.subtitle: Monthly, quarterly or yearly. Cancel or pause from your account.

shop.title: Fuel, without the guesswork.
shop.subtitle: Picked by our coaches. Pick up at the gym or get it delivered in Amman.

coaches.title: People who've lifted what you're lifting.

about.title: Why
about.p1: GRAMS GYM was founded to be the first destination for serious athletes in Jordan. We don't just offer a place to train — we offer an arena to prove yourself.
about.p2: Over {years}+ years we've built a community of {members}+ athletes committed to transforming their bodies and their lives. Our slogan, "Each Gram Matters", isn't just words — it's a method: every gram of iron, every gram of effort and every gram of nutrition builds your strongest self.
about.p3: We equip our facility with the newest and heaviest equipment on the market to meet the needs of bodybuilding champions and professional athletes, while giving determined beginners a safe, supportive environment.

discipline.title: Absolute discipline
discipline.body: We don't believe in excuses. We provide the environment and the equipment; you bring the effort and the commitment.

energy.title: Maximum energy
energy.body: An atmosphere full of drive and positive energy that pushes you past your limits every session.

community.title: A strong community
community.body: You're not alone. Join a community of athletes who share your passion and ambition.

about.vision: GRAMS GYM began as the idea of a complete sports center that brings together the strongest equipment, the best coaches and a full athletic community that pushes you to become the best version of yourself.
about.strength: Designed to be Jordan's number-one center for fitness and bodybuilding, with the newest and most powerful iron and advanced fitness machines.

services.title: Everything you need to build. Nothing you don't.

training.title: Bodybuilding & strength
training.body: Free weights, racks and plate-loaded machines for heavy, progressive training.

personal.title: Personal training
personal.body: One-to-one coaching with a program, technique work and weekly accountability.

nutrition.title: Nutrition plans
nutrition.body: Practical meal plans that fit your goal and your week — no fad diets.

cardio.title: Cardio & conditioning
cardio.body: A full cardio zone to build your engine alongside your strength.

weights.title: Free-weight zone
weights.body: A full dumbbell line-up and heavy plates for serious sessions.

machines.title: Resistance machines
machines.body: Selectorized and plate-loaded machines for every muscle group.

cardio.title: Cardio zone
cardio.body: Treadmills, bikes and cross-trainers by the windows.

lounge.title: Coaching corner
lounge.body: Assessments, programming and nutrition consultations with our coaches.

footer.about: Jordan's number-one Muscle Factory. Equipped with the newest and heaviest equipment to meet the needs of professional athletes and to produce champions.
